description: Source file implementing a response notifier for Nordic's nRF 802.15.4 spinel protocol, managing response synchronization, property waiting, and notification handling.

methods.name: nrf_802154_spinel_response_notifier_init
methods.description: Initializes the response notifier, setting the buffer as free and initializing the mutex.

methods.name: nrf_802154_spinel_response_notifier_lock_before_request
methods.description: Locks the response notifier mutex before sending a request, setting the awaited property.

methods.name: nrf_802154_spinel_response_notifier_property_await
methods.description: Waits for a response property within a specified timeout, returning the notification buffer if received.

methods.name: nrf_802154_spinel_response_notifier_free
methods.description: Frees the notification buffer and unlocks the mutex after processing.

methods.name: nrf_802154_spinel_response_notifier_property_notify
methods.description: Handles incoming property notifications, copying data if it matches the awaited property.
